description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ThemeService in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It contains test cases verifying theme-related functionalities such as displaying social media images, retrieving theme variables, and fetching theme images, with a focus on different predefined themes and caching behavior.

classes.name: ThemeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ThemeService functionalities such as theme variable retrieval, social media image display toggles, and image fetching logic within the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by loading fixture data from a YAML file into the TestDataService.

methods.name: testShowSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Tests the behavior of showSocialMediaImages method for default and custom themes, including caching effects.

methods.name: testGetCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Verifies that the getCurrentThemeVariables method correctly returns theme-specific CSS variables for custom and default themes, including caching behavior.

methods.name: testGetImageETagWithNullImage
methods.description: Checks that getting the image ETag for a non-existent or null image returns null, indicating the absence of the image.

methods.name: testGetImage
methods.description: Validates that the getImage method correctly retrieves an image object with the expected filename.

methods.name: testGetImageWithNullImage
methods.description: Ensures that getImage returns null when the specified image does not exist.
